::: {#exm-parameter-space}
#### Parameter spaces and priors that respect them

- A probability $\pi$ has parameter space $(0, 1)$,
  so its prior should be a distribution on the unit interval,
  such as the uniform prior of @exm-prior.
- A variance $\sigma^2$ has parameter space $(0, \infty)$,
  so its prior should be a distribution on the positive half-line.
- A vector of $p$ regression coefficients has parameter space $\reals^p$,
  so its prior should be a distribution on $\reals^p$.
:::
